functions.notes: Size and shape match. Only the kind==7 nibble block (+0x2bc..+0x324) differs: the target tests m%2 (tst r1,#0xff) before computing the nib base (sl+0xc, +0x400) and m>>1, while ours hoists the base add ahead of the tst. Tried i/odd/nib declaration orders, inline condition, per-branch pointers, ternary, hoisted load and colorsweep --apply. Levers that closed the rest: signed (int)n % 8 with unsigned n and n >> 3 (lsr), i declared before mask, unsigned char r/g/b, unsigned m = (n-0xae)&0xff with unsigned char odd and i.
